GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS AND

Kristina Duggan, Chair

Mary Zendejas, Member

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

 CALL TO ORDER

 At 4:23 PM, Chair Duggan called the meeting to order.

 ROLL CALL

 Councilmembers Present: Ricks-Oddie, Duggan

 Councilmembers Absent: Zendejas

 Also present: Erin Weesner-McKinley, Principal Deputy City Attorney, Tamela Austin, City Clerk
 Analyst, Matthew Bunma, City Clerk Specialist.

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  25-56165  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Government Operations and
  Efficiency Committee meeting of Tuesday, July 22, 2025.

  A motion was made by Vice Chair Ricks-Oddie, seconded by Chair Duggan, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  2  Ricks-Oddie, Duggan
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Zendejas

 2.  25-56166  Recommendation to receive Charter Commission appointments and
  reappointments pursuant to Section 509 of the City Charter and Section 2.03.065
  of the Long Beach Municipal Code, and forward this item to the City Council for
  approval.

  A motion was made by Vice Chair Ricks-Oddie, seconded by Chair Duggan, to
  approve recommendation, as amended, correcting the term for Edgar
  Campbell on the Police Oversight Commission to reflect that he is serving a
  partial term from September 16, 2025 to June 30, 2026 filling a vacancy
  position left by Charlie Parkins, and can be reappointed to serve his first term
